one_line: Cloud helpdesk with a comprehensive REST API (v2) covering tickets, contacts, conversations, solutions, and admin objects.
auth_notes: API key authenticates via HTTP basic auth (API key as the password); per-product APIs (Freshdesk, Freshsales, etc. each have their own). Full v2 API at /api/v2 with rate limits per hour.
self_serve_notes: Free tier (Sprout) exists; API key is self-serve from account settings in any Freshdesk account.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Tickets, contacts, agents, companies, conversations, solutions, surveys, products, ticket fields, time entries, satisfaction ratings
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks supported in Freshdesk automations for ticket/contact events

existing_mcp.note: No official Freshdesk MCP server found; community servers exist on GitHub/MCP registry

evidence.note: Fetched text was the full Freshdesk API reference (26k+ lines) confirming endpoints, auth, and rate limits
